description: Subscribes in the template, marks the view for check on each value and unsubscribes on destroy. Returns `null` before the first value.
Operator from `@angular/core/rxjs-interop` that completes the stream when the current `DestroyRef` is destroyed.
Injectable handle of the current component/service lifecycle; `onDestroy(fn)` registers cleanup.
Completes the source when `notifier$` emits. Legacy cleanup pattern with a `destroy$` Subject.
A subscription that outlives its component, keeping callbacks and memory alive.
